"...Alright, that does it for the floor!
Next is the dust on the desks—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh nooo!
The sand bottle is...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
But... but...
It was my favorite...

Having broken her favorite sand bottle,
Daring Heart was feeling down in the dumps.
